note: FFX2-G06 item accounting (stock count 0x620ba0, stock add or subtract 0x620e80, gil subtract 0x60d4b0, reserve 0x620d90, refund or commit 0x620c00). w = the world before: i = the 68 slot ids (u16 LE hex), c = the 68 counts (hex), sp = the special id, g = gil, b = the bitmap words an operation can touch, keyed by word index (gained bitmap 0..15, used bitmap 16..). post = what changed (s = [slot, id, count], sp, g, b). rec = [got (+0x8e), needed (+0x8f), id0 (+0x90), id1 (+0x92), gil needed (+0xb0), gil reserved (+0xb4)]. src emulator: regenerated bit for bit from the note's own proof and checked equal to the emulator's logged answer here; src oracle: the note's independent model, proved equal to the real function over 30,000 vectors.
